text:
alex: Quick heads-up — mini sample app (Next.js + LlamaIndex) in the repo is hitting an auth/retry nit during onboarding. reproduce steps and tiny logs below, thinking it's either env naming or SDK middleware parity. anyone seen this?

jess: :eyes: saw similar with another starter, usually env mismatch. which env vars are you setting?

alex: Steps:
1) git clone github.com/redwood-inference/mini-sample-app
2) cd example/next-llamaindex-playground && yarn
3) .env.local:
```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx
NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_URL=https://api.redwood.example
```
4) yarn dev -> first request to /api/llama/query returns 401, SDK tries 3 retries then throws `AuthError: token invalid` and the UI shows spinner forever.

samir: That stack looks like the node SDK's auth middleware not rotating when it sees a 401 and `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` flow. Python SDK had a fix last month. Are you on `@redwood/sdk-js@0.9.5`?

alex: yep 0.9.5 in package.json.

jess: we patched 0.9.6 to add a refresh-on-401 tolerance, but only in the hosted flow. Could be the local playground uses the legacy `NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_URL` pattern — half the starters still expect `REDWOOD_API_URL`.

maria: I'll open a tiny docs PR to call out the required env names for the mini app and add a `seed-kv` script. will also add a one-liner under troubleshooting: `If you see AuthError on first request, check REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_URL envs.` @alex can you confirm which var is actually checked in the server console?

alex: quick paste from server log: `env.REDWOOD_API_URL undefined, using NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_URL` then `fetch token -> 401 -> retryCount=3 -> throw`. So starter falls back to the public var and into a code path that doesn't handle refresh.

samir: ok this sounds like SDK parity issue + starter fallback. I'll open an SDK issue:  https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/412 (WIP) and add labels `sdk-bug`, `parity`. Will try to repro locally with a mocked 401 and write a failing unit test.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary `devex-playground` updated: `@redwood/sdk-js@0.9.7` rolled to staging (contains refresh-on-401 middleware).

jess: nice :shipit: if 0.9.7 fixes it we should update the sample template deps and cut a tiny patch release for the starter.

maria: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/128 — adds env var table + troubleshooting.

alex: thanks all — will try the canary and report back. if it still fails i'll paste minimal failing curl and logs. :thumbsup:

samir: FYI I'll add a CI test for the starter that spins up the sample app and runs a simple auth smoke test so we don't regress.

alex: perfect. thanks everyone!
